name: Botpress
tagline: Botpress is an open-source conversational AI platform for building, deploying, and managing chatbots and virtual agents. It combines a visual flow builder with LLM integration, allowing developers and non-technical users to create sophisticated bots for customer support, sales, and internal automation.
